snippet.title: IMAN | Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Demo is now available to play: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4529210/Iman/

IMAN is an 8-bit Religious Horror Adventure, putting you in the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man who must confront the possessed, the power of Dark Magic, and mystical beings.
